reviewed_by: Claude: queue or interrupt messages in chats and Butler mode
reason: While an agent works, Enter queues the message in Core's follow-up queue and Send now (Cmd/Ctrl+Enter) interrupts. Core: QueueWrite gains interrupt (enqueue first, unpause, resume_after_turn_id = the running turn) and an 'interrupt' action that moves a waiting item first; a sending item's turn cancelled for an interrupt no longer pauses the queue. UI: one shared QueuedMessages stack (Send now, edit, reorder, remove, pause, clear) replaces ChatQueuePanel's details panel and ButlerQueue's list; SessionsPage stopAndSend uses one interrupt enqueue instead of pause/enqueue/stop/resume and is offered whenever Core reports the provider busy; the Butler panel gains Send now; Butler mode threads queue replies to an answering thread (previously refused) and reload the transcript when a queued reply moves. Guide, settings-assistant doc and knowledge index updated. Also fixes a race in test_core_update_reclaimed_provider_turn_keeps_linked_follow_up_running (red on origin/main): Core's own queue loop can settle the item before the test's manual step.
exclusions: thinking.spec.ts and workspace-recovery.spec.ts queue cases were updated but not selected: their fixtures (tests/v3/thinking_fixture.py, workspace_recovery_fixture.py) fail at startup on origin/main with "'coroutine' object has no attribute 'id'" (un-awaited NebulaStore.create). The original butler-queue.spec.ts panel journey (area:butler-queue) is not selected: it times out on origin/main: the Butler launcher now opens Butler mode instead of the floating panel, so openButler never finds the panel dialog. The new Butler mode Send now journey (area:butler-send-now) passed locally on a disposable LAN Core in assistant-real-desktop, -compact, -chromium-320/390 and -webkit-320/390. real-core.spec.ts queue cases (summary disclosure, 'Move message N up') were not updated: the file exceeds the public commit guard size limit and main does not run it.
